newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Banco Provincia lowers mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Banco Provincia lowers mortgage rates.

text.p: Argentina's state-owned Banco Provincia de Buenos Aires announced a new scheme which will lower interest rates on dollar-denominated mortgages to below 10 percent for the first time, bank officials said Friday.

The scheme, which goes into effect Monday, will finance 100 percent of purchases of new homes worth up to $100,000 and 75 percent of purchases of previously-owned homes at an annual rate of 9.75 percent in dollars or 11 percent in pesos.
The loans may be taken out for five, eight, 10, 12 and 15 years.

In the first three months of the year, fixed peso rates averaged 14.4 percent for 10 to five-year loans and rates on dollar loans averaged 13.2 percent for loans for longer than 10 years, according to a survey carried out by the Argentine Business University.
